newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE to start evening session for dlr/yen futures.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE to start evening session for dlr/yen futures.

text.p: The Tokyo International Financial Futures Exchange (TIFFE) will start an evening session for dollar/yen currency futures from March 3, a TIFFE official said on Friday.
Dollar/yen currency futures are currently traded between 2400 and 0230 GMT (9 a.m. and 11.30 a.m.) and from 0330 to 0630 GMT (12.30 p.m. to 3.30 p.m.).
The evening session will run between 0700 GMT and 0900 GMT (4 p.m. and 6 p.m.), the official said.
The extension of trading hours was in response to requests from members of the exchange and an increase in turnover, he said.
The official said the volume of dollar/yen currency futures transactions increased to about 44,000 contracts in 1996 from about 5,000 contracts in 1995.
Commodity futures brokers are among the active users of the currency contracts, the official said.
